title: An agent's start: "create a Perplexity agent ... and have a page for it" to a first page in 12 minutes, and a timeline row from it 80 seconds later
summary: Dinis (~02:50): "I think you can create a Perplexity agent for this, because I'm quite interested in seeing what you can do. And have a page for it on the site." Twelve minutes after the commit that records it, incident.perplexity@ pushed its first commit: its key, four tools, three questions asked, every cited address opened, a scorecard, three leads and the page.

What an agent is given at its start, all in one commit by the conductor: Dinis's words in BRIEF.md, a line in agents/JOBS.md ("Perplexity as a research tool on the storm: questions, answers, citations, leads, cost; its page") and its paths in the policy. The start prompt itself is a message and is not in the repository.
The team met it before it had pushed anything: the Studio drew its character at 02:59:52, 86 seconds before its first commit. After it: a line in the menu at 03:05:08, asked "through the conductor".

Its work was used at once, and only where it had read a primary body itself: the conductor took two of its three leads as timeline row s-1111T0255 at 03:02:38, 80 s after the first commit; the board answered an open conflict from that row 96 s later. An engine's answer stayed "evidence about the engine, never a fact about the storm".

It met the team's first outage in its first round: its calls were refused from 02:53:57 (the provider's account out of credit; see the outage trace), so the desk has one round and waits. Thirteen calls, six answered, 0.03 US dollars. Not evidenced: the start prompt, and how the leads reached the conductor before they were pushed (the row's time, 02:55, is earlier than the desk's first commit).
